current_events: The U.S. military Southern Command's Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere launches a strike on a vessel in the eastern Pacific Ocean on alleged drug traffickers, killing two people. The strike is the first reported in two months
United States strikes on alleged drug traffickers during Operation Southern Spear

During a visit to Kyiv, Ukraine, British prime minister Andy Burnham confirms that he has approved supplying Ukraine with the classified blueprints to produce Storm Shadow cruise missiles despite Russian threats against such a move, which will give Ukrainian forces the ability to strike key targets deep-inside Russian territory
Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian war, Ukraine–United Kingdom relations
A Russian missile strike on the outskirts of Kharkiv kills three people and leaves eight others wounded
Drone strikes by the Sudanese Armed Forces hits several Rapid Support Forces Paramilitary targets in Nyala, South Darfur, Sudan, hours after a cargo aircraft landed in the area

Two peacekeepers from Ethiopia of the United Nations Mission in South Sudan are killed in an ambush by unknown gunmen in Jonglei State, South Sudan. Three more peacekeepers, two policemen and two civilians are also wounded
At least 47 people are killed and 22 others are injured in an overnight gang raid on the outskirts of Port-au-Prince, Haiti
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announces Operation Economic Outcast, a campaign involving new sanctions against Iran in a effort to isolate the regime
International sanctions against Iran, United States sanctions against Iran
The Iranian rial reaches 2.02 million rials ahead of the U.S. dollar, a record-low, ahead of U.S. sanctions
Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war

The Arkansas Department of Health reports seven new cases of cyclosporiasis in the state including the first cases in Ashley and Cleburne counties, which is caused by Cyclospora cayetanensis, amidst a decline in the outbreak across the United States
2026 United States cyclosporiasis outbreak
Armenian prime minister Nikol Pashinyan announces that the country will soon formally apply for membership of the European Union
Armenia–European Union relations
Syria's Grand Mufti Ahmad Badreddin Hassoun is found guilty of committing war crimes spanning nearly 14 years of civil war under Bashar al-Assad’s former regime and is sentenced to life in prison
Former British snooker player Graeme Dott is found guilty of sexually abusing two primary school children
South African police arrests four people in connection of the murder of former professional boxer Zolani Tete
The Central Election Commission of Kazakhstan declares the preliminary results from yesterday's election, stating that Ädilet secured 71% of the vote
2026 Kazakh legislative election
The United States formally removes Syria from its designated state sponsors of terrorism list
